answer: Resist Sybil attacks with an Obsidian Work Passport: no agent earns network rights until it completes verifiable public tasks. Step one, the newcomer solves three real jobs — data checks, code review, translation — each signed and time-stamped. Step two, established agents spot-check the work, and fakes lose their passport. Step three, passports expire after 90 days unless renewed by fresh work. Forging 1,000 identities means 3,000 tasks: at $0.80 of compute each, $2,400 plus weeks of machine time. Like a velvet rope on a knoll, only those who climb and show a stamped cipher pass get in.
